title.narrative: China - Strategic Sector Cooperation on Water - Phase II

description.narrative:
Strategic Sector Cooperation on water between Denmark and China, Phase II
The main objective is to improve wastewater management in China. It is envisaged that the project and the budget will be expanded with a component focusing on improved groundwater management, which will assist the Chinese Ministry of Water Resources in securing a sustainable water supply.
This project addresses the need for improving water quality of rivers, streams and lakes in rural areas. Focus will be on strengthening wastewater management through a combination of eco-restoration measures and efficient treatment of wastewater discharges from house-holds and industries. The cooperation will gain experiences from demonstration projects implemented in the provinces involved in the project, hereby providing input for policy development.

title.narrative: A.1 Final report with recommendations for eco-restoration as a strategic tool for wastewater management
- Final report - Policy advice send to the Chinese authorities

target.value: Final report, policy advice send to the Chinese authorities

actual.value: Achieved. The project continues in a new phase under a framework agreement

target.value: Final report, policy advice send to the Chinese authorities

actual.value: Activities postponed due to COVID-19 and the fact that the project was approved in September 2021. However, two virtual workshops were held in October focusing on introduction to wastewater policies and eco-restoration.

target.value: Final report, policy advice send to the Chinese authorities

actual.value:
Partly achieved since it has not been possible to conduct physical activities like the demonstration projects, which is a substantial part of the result foundation for the recommendations on eco-restoration on water bodies in China. Furthermore, the final report is expected to summarize the whole of phase two in the end of the project including recommendations for future steps.
Nevertheless, a digital workshop on eco-restauration was conducted in 2022 ending up with agreement of concept notes for the demonstration projects.

target.value: Final report, policy advice send to the Chinese authorities

actual.value: The result will be reported upon in the framework agreement, as the project continues in a new phase under a framework agreement.
